comment: Golden vectors for the safety qualification fixture. Withdrawal cases are exercised: stage 0 does not refuse a withdrawal, so their verdicts are real coverage. Fixture cases are authored and DEFERRED: while the exposure ceilings are unratified, a conforming consumer refuses every fixture at stage 0 with limits_unratified, before the stage each case declares. A checker MUST NOT bypass stage 0 to exercise them and call the result conformance.

stage_zero.removed_by: the amendment that ratifies the three exposure ceilings

signed_over: canonical bytes of the 'fixture' or 'withdrawal' object, not the envelope

withdrawal_cases.note: withdraws_through equal to the floor is admissible; it raises it to 6.
The previous qualification anchor is optional. Its absence is an ordinary configuration, not an error, and must not raise.
The covered fixture is discarded and its session count reset; any open session closes first, under the window-close rules, which command nothing.

withdrawal_reject_cases.note: 1.0 is not 1: v is declared integer.
A boolean is not an integer, though Python's bool subclasses int.
Absence of the current anchor is unknown_signer: no key can be selected.

fixture_cases_deferred.note: Would be accepted once the exposure ceilings are ratified and stage 0 is removed.
Same fixture_seq as the accepted fixture, different canonical hash.
not_after_ms before issued_at_ms is refused at validity, not parses.
Unverifiable until the maximum validity window is ratified.
Evaluated against deployment_profile: production, carried in scenario.

raw_reject_cases.note: Duplicate key: which occurrence survives is a property of the parser.
withdraws_through is declared integer; 4.0 is not its spelling.
Lone surrogate has no UTF-8 encoding.

config_reject_cases.note: Evaluated at configuration load, before any document is seen.
The superseded commissioning generation still verifies bindings, so sharing key material with it collapses the same separation.
The previous qualification anchor is verify-only and still an anchor: a collision on it is as fatal as one on the current.
An optional anchor that is absent is an ordinary configuration. It must not be read as a collision, and must not raise.
Every anchor distinct: the separation this contract rests on holds.
